title: Migrate RecipesListView to catalog-backed sections
description: Replace `RecipesListView`'s local scan state with environment-driven catalog state. Preserve the current grouped rendering and display-name search behavior, and add `.refreshable` to invoke the catalog reload path.
acceptance_criteria: `RecipesListView` no longer calls `RecipeDiscovery.scan` or stores scanned sections in local loading state.
The list renders grouped catalog data, preserves the existing display-name-only searchable predicate, and uses catalog loading signals for cold-start empty/loading behavior.
Pull-to-refresh is wired with `.refreshable` and triggers a catalog reload without flickering to an empty list.

handoff_summary.completed: Replaced local @State sections: [FolderSection]? and .task { RecipeDiscovery.scan } with @Environment(RecipeCatalog.self) and catalog.sections. Rewrote filteredSections to filter over CatalogSection/RecipeEntry. Cold-start loading uses catalog.isLoaded instead of sections == nil. .refreshable calls catalog.reload() and polls catalog.isLoading to hold the spinner without clearing sections (anti-flicker). RecipeEntry is converted to RecipeFile at point of use so RecipeRowView and RecipeDetailSheet are untouched. Updated RecipesTab.swift to drop the folderURL argument.
handoff_summary.risks: RecipeRowView and RecipeDetailSheet still accept RecipeFile — the conversion RecipeEntry→RecipeFile is done inline in RecipesListView. If RecipeDetailSheet is later migrated to accept RecipeEntry (to use the pre-parsed recipe), these conversion sites must be updated.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify: list renders catalog sections, search filters by display name, pull-to-refresh triggers reload and spinner stays until load completes, cold-start shows Color.clear then list.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: RecipesTab.swift was outside the declared expected_globs but required updating for the call site. No other sibling beads are known to touch these files.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: RecipeEntry→RecipeFile conversion done inline in RecipesListView rather than changing RecipeRowView/RecipeDetailSheet signatures, keeping change scope minimal. Polling loop in .refreshable uses 100ms intervals to hold the SwiftUI spinner until catalog.isLoading becomes false.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests run per developer guardrails. Tester agent should cover: catalog-backed grouping, display-name search predicate, pull-to-refresh lifecycle, empty state (not loaded vs. loaded-but-empty), no-match state.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The empty state subtitle no longer mentions the folder name (was folderURL.lastPathComponent). A generic message is used. If folder name is desired, RecipesListView can add @Environment(RecipesFolderStore.self).

conflict_risks: RecipesTab.swift was outside the declared expected_globs but required updating for the call site. No other sibling beads are known to touch these files.

execution_history.summary: Migrated RecipesListView from local RecipeDiscovery.scan state to environment-driven RecipeCatalog. Removed folderURL parameter, replaced FolderSection/RecipeFile scan state with CatalogSection/RecipeEntry from the environment catalog, added .refreshable wired to catalog.reload(), updated RecipesTab call site. Build succeeds.
